episodes.title: Birth Trauma, Cults, Rock Bottom & 29 Years Sober | Luke Storey | Brain Supreme Podcast Ep. 34
episodes.description:
Luke Storey spent two years reliving everything he'd spent decades healing from to write A Horse Named Lonesome — and he calls it his ego death.

Luke walks Adam through the memoir: being separated from his mother at birth, a childhood that pulled him into addiction before he was a teenager, a troubled-teen school born out of a cult, and the Rottweiler bite that set off the rock bottom that got him sober 29 years ago. They also get into why loneliness sits beneath every addiction, how addiction keeps progressing even through abstinence, and a plant-medicine vision of his own birth that his mom later confirmed.

Adam also shares the conversation with his mother that changed how he showed up for her in her final years.
